title: idemcore-verifier: open log format, verifier and evidence for bit-identical LLM inference across CPUs, phones and GPUs
description:
Open half of Idemcore, an LLM inference engine whose runs are bit-identical across x86-64 CPUs, ARM phones and NVIDIA GPUs. This archive contains the hash-log format specification (v1, including multi-stream logs), a dependency-free Python verifier, the measurement methodology, and raw per-token hash logs from real runs on x86-64, Windows ARM64, a Galaxy Z Fold5 (Android) and NVIDIA GPUs from Turing to Blackwell, for Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-7B (8-bit and 4-bit), gpt-oss-20b/120b, Idemcore 27B and Idemcore 35B (MoE), single-stream and with many concurrent streams. One command (python3 -m idemcore_verify samples) recomputes every published digest from the logs and prints PASS or FAIL.

The inference engine itself is not included and is not open source.
